title: What Is Uterine Fibroid Surgery?
description: What uterine fibroid surgery (myomectomy) is, what it involves, what it is for and when it is indicated. Care in Lima with price alternatives.
tldr: Myomectomy removes fibroids (benign tumors of the uterus) while preserving the uterus, which is useful if you want to keep your fertility. The specialist decides the indication; results vary from person to person.
bodyHtml:
Myomectomy removes fibroids (benign tumors of the uterus) while preserving the uterus, which is useful if you want to keep your fertility.

How is it done?

Laparoscopic, hysteroscopic or open, depending on the size and location of the fibroids.

When is it indicated?

Symptomatic fibroids (bleeding, pain, pressure) when you wish to preserve the uterus. The gynecologist decides.
